messages.subject: G/1457/25B - Information on Damage cargo received at Kandla Port / Policy No. 21-H0963406
messages.bodyText:
Dear Respective,

Greetings from Sojitz India Private Limited!

We wish to inform you that upon receipt of our cargo at Kandla Port., Kutch , Gujarat, certain damages were observed during the initial inspection.
The shipment details are as follows:

· Consignee: Sojitz Machinery Corporation
· Port of Discharge: Kandla Port , Kutch, Gujarat, India
· Vessel / Voyage No.: MV.HE SHENG DONG FANG V.SP25271
· Bill of Lading No.: 271SHKD01
· Commodity: Used Blanking Press [BL1000T]
· Policy / Cover Note No.: 21-H0963406 [Ref. Attachment]

The damage noticed includes visible damage – e.g., broken packaging etc.].

We want to request to initiate joint survey along with port authorities and shipping line representatives.

Kindly acknowledge this as our first intimation of claim under the above policy.

Please advise us on the immediate steps required, including nomination of your surveyor at the earliest.

We shall extend our full cooperation to facilitate the inspection and provide all required supporting documents.

Looking forward to your guidance and confirmation.

Thanks & Regards,
Mahak Khanna
Manager - Machinery Department
Sojitz India Private Limited
